en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a canal scene in an old European city. On the left are stepped-gable brick houses in Flemish style, with people walking along the cobbled quay. A small boat with several passengers moves along the canal toward a low stone bridge in the center of the image. Tall trees line the right-hand bank. Handwritten ink at the top shows a date, and printed text at the bottom identifies the view.
